DLC2308:3:t_1:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...You can't fight on an empty stomach... That is the most basic principle of warfare...」

DLC2308:3:t_1:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「'A samurai proudly picks his teeth even when he hasn't eaten'... If you took that literally, your entire army would be wiped out in no time...」

DLC2308:3:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...The story I am about to tell takes place on the eve of the assault on $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

DLC2308:3:t_1:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A concentrated breakthrough into the stronghold of a powerful enemy... To ease the pressure, some volunteers organized a modest feast.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$: Hangar～

DLC2308:3:t_2:6.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Tomorrow, at last, we begin the assault on $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:7.en:
$$ブライト$$
「As I look forward to everyone's efforts to bring this war to an end...」

DLC2308:3:t_2:8.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I offer my condolences to all those who have fallen in the fighting so far.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:10.en:
$$クェス$$
「Captain $$ブライト$$! That's enough of the speech, isn't it!?」

DLC2308:3:t_2:11.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$クェス$$ is right. All this food will get cold.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:15.en:
$$郁絵$$
「The household team and our volunteers prepared the food for this party. Please, help yourselves.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:16.en:
$$甲児$$
「These Rust Hurricane Croquettes are my pride and joy. Try my new Breast Fire Steak too.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's steak seared in an instant over extremely high heat. Getting it cooked this perfectly isn't easy.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:19.en:
$$アルト$$
「Cooking that wild is fine for camping. Try my Japanese food instead.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:20.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Mmm... Delicate seasoning and presentation, just like you, $$アルト$$. One could call this a work of art.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:21.en:
$$カレン$$
「It's hard to take that seriously when you're still wearing your mask.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:22.en:
$n
「You're too soft, $$アルト$$. A real man's cooking is survival cooking.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:25.en:
$n
「I gathered the ingredients locally for this party and cooked them to bring out their natural qualities.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:26.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...I'm sorry, $n... I don't think I can...」

DLC2308:3:t_2:27.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't force yourself, $$セツコ$$. We girls can't handle the way this looks...」

DLC2308:3:t_2:29.en:
$$マオ$$
「Of course not. This goes way beyond wild. It's entered the realm of freak food.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:30.en:
$n
「But some people are wolfing it down.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:34.en:
$$シン$$
「That bunch doesn't look likely to call anything delicious, no matter what they're eating.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:35.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「By the way, $$キリコ$$... What's your favorite food?」

DLC2308:3:t_2:38.en:
$$レド$$
「The seaweed bread I ate with the $$ガルガンティア船団$$.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:41.en:
$$宗介$$
「I see, $$ヒイロ$$. You've gotten hooked on that flavor too.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:42.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Speaking of which, your tastes have gotten pretty refined, haven't they, $$宗介$$?」

DLC2308:3:t_2:44.en:
$$さやか$$
「That's true. When he's in Japan, he eats $$かなめ$$'s home cooking.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:47.en:
$$シモン$$
「Love really is the greatest spice.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:48.en:
$$シモン$$
「So, here's a favorite of mine that $$ニア$$ used to make for me. Everyone, have some.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:50.en:
$$ダリー$$
（That dish... To be honest, only $$シモン$$ likes the taste...）

DLC2308:3:t_2:51.en:
$$ギミー$$
（More like it's poison to anyone else!）

DLC2308:3:t_2:52.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
（Back during the $$破界事変$$, it really put $$ロシウ$$ through hell.）

DLC2308:3:t_2:53.en:
$$シモン$$
「Don't be shy. I made plenty, so dig in.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:55.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Th-thanks, but I'm already full from Major $$オズマ$$'s pineapple cake.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:56.en:
$$シモン$$
「What about you, Captain $$アムロ$$?」

DLC2308:3:t_2:57.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I... had $$アストナージ$$'s salad.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:58.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「What's with you all? Getting full from that little food... Are you nervous about the big battle!?」

DLC2308:3:t_2:59.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Exactly. Let's all enjoy this food full of $$シモン$$'s love!」

DLC2308:3:t_2:60.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Why don't you try some too, $$レド$$?」

DLC2308:3:t_2:61.en:
$$レド$$
「Good idea. I've never seen food this color before...」

DLC2308:3:t_2:66.en:
$$ガロード$$
「H-hey! $$ピニオン$$!? $$ピニオン$$!!」

DLC2308:3:t_2:72.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「You ignored this unit's warning. This outcome was inevitable.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:73.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Endless variety, a dazzling array, screams of agony... Quite an assortment of distinctive dishes, Managing Director $$厚井$$.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:74.en:
$$厚井$$
「Indeed. I'm sure everyone has been able to relax before the decisive battle.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:75.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「What do you think, Managing Director? Don't you want to decide which dish is number one?」

DLC2308:3:t_2:77.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'd like you to try at least a bite of each and give us your critique.」

DLC2308:3:t_2:78.en:
$$厚井$$
「I-I'm an employee of $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$. Mechanics are one thing, but cooking is...」

review.context: On the eve of Wrath Babylon, a potluck provides comic relief. Kouji and Alto offer contrasting food, Hibiki's survival cooking repels many, and Simon's recreation of Nia's dish incapacitates Pinion, Nono and Ledo. Roger teases Atsui about food criticism.
decisions: The samurai proverb retains its hunger-versus-pride image.
Rust Hurricane Croquettes and Breast Fire Steak retain Kouji's attack-themed dish names.
Calorie Friend is the fictional ration product, not a person or untranslated asset.
Chamber's speaker uses the pilot token, and Simon uses the Gurren pilot token rather than Luca's UAV.
Noriko and Amuro's food excuses preserve the pineapple-cake and salad references without extra explanation.
Caption repair preserves the source blank header, blank lines, indentation and fullwidth wave decorations; the translated location remains in the body.
